summary: Abstract The fluorescence characteristics of an OLED material are demonstrated to be linear with sunlight‐like illuminance levels up to several suns. It is therefore possible to make laboratory reflection measurements with much lower illuminance levels and scale them to sunlight levels to qualify such displays for sunlight readability.
